register: Património Classificado dos Açores: Exemplares Arbóreos (classified trees of the Azores)
authority: Direção Regional da Cultura (data owner) with Secretaria Regional do Ambiente e Ação Climática (geodata), Governo dos Açores
licence_proof: GeoNetwork metadata record 0d09ba25-2b90-4576-9838-f37bea740779 on sma.idea.azores.gov.pt (Património Classificado dos Açores), useLimitation/otherConstraints: 'Licença de utilização - CC-BY-4.0 (https://creativecoomons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)' [sic, typo in the record]; access constraint 'Acesso público sem restrições'. The WFS service record 1ec3f773-901c-4dcd-a5ec-17e9f67b8dde reads 'acesso e uso sem condições'. Read 2026-11-02.
attribution: Governo dos Açores, Direção Regional da Cultura / SRAAC, Património Classificado dos Açores
scope: Every tree classified in the Azores before the RRAIPA: the 1984 Horta decree (DLR 28/84/A), the 1982 Água de Alto dragon trees (DR 8/82/A with DRR 30/83/A), the 1985 Posto Santo cork oak (DLR 7/85/A), Diário do Governo despachos of 1965 to 1970 (the old national AIP regime), and one 2011 Council resolution (Furnas araucaria); all carried over by DLR 3/2015/A art. 41, later revoked by DLR 27/2022/A. 49 records, 58 specimens (one record is a group of ten eucalyptus on Monte Brasil), matching the 58 (37 Faial, 14 Terceira, 7 São Miguel) cited in 2022 within a record or two.
notes: No girth, height or age fields: the register only names species, site, owner and act. Coordinates are the region's own georeferencing (EPSG:5013 reprojected server-side to EPSG:4326); 44 of 49 carry the note that the location 'carece de verificação/confirmação no terreno', four add 'pode já nem existir no local' (may no longer exist), so every pin defaults to approximate and every tree needs a life check. Cross-check for Horta: Regulamento n.º 1055/2023 (Município da Horta, DR 2.ª série n.º 192, 3 Oct 2023, Anexo III, https://files.diariodarepublica.pt/2s/2023/10/192000000/0032300360.pdf) lists 30 public-interest trees in 21 rows, a few fewer than the region's 36 Faial points. The RRAIPA created by DRR 2/2026/A (6 Mar 2026) is to be published on drrf.azores.gov.pt, which sat behind a Cloudflare challenge on 2026-11-02; this file is the pre-RRAIPA list. Many owners are private (proprietario 'Particular'); check access per tree before shipping (hard rule 10).
